title: What early bands played and when ragtime dancing began
summary: Concerts, parades, picnics, meter and quadrilles; ragtime dancing came long after the Spanish-American War.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
